title: HP-FFT: A General High-Performance FFT Generator Using High-Level Synthesis
problem: Existing FFT HLS IP libraries suffer from low throughput and poor usability due to inadequate parallelism exploitation, while high-throughput RTL FFT designs lack portability and flexibility.
motivation: FFT is a foundational algorithm widely used in digital signal processing and machine learning, requiring efficient hardware implementations.
method: The approach analyzes FFT loop structures to find places where calculations at different levels can run in parallel—called hierarchical parallelism, which means different stages of the algorithm progress simultaneously rather than sequentially. HP-FFT automatically generates hardware designs from this analysis with adjustable parallelism settings. This tuning dial lets designers choose between using less silicon and power or achieving faster data throughput.
key_novelty: The core idea is using automatic hardware generation to systematically find and exploit multiple levels of parallelism within FFT algorithms, balancing high throughput with hardware portability.
contributions: In-depth analysis revealing hierarchical parallelism opportunities in FFT loop structures
HP-FFT generator with customizable parallelism settings and multi-functionality support
Achieves performance matching or exceeding state-of-the-art RTL and HLS implementations
Enables flexible resource-throughput trade-offs for diverse application requirements

metrics.other: matches or outperforms state-of-the-art RTL/HLS FFT implementations in throughput

primary_theme: HLS-based FFT generator with hierarchical parallelism
